title: external-datasource-federated-read: federated read returns empty — the external object→remote-table mapping never registers (boot ordering)
body:
Blocked-by: #7738

> **Status 2026-08-11 (engine-core seat):** the ordering mechanism this card names is fixed by PR #7788 (`Part of`, not `Fixes`). ⚠️ **The Root cause section below is FALSIFIED** — the `if (!driver)` skip is real but *compensated* (`DatasourceConnectionService.attemptConnect` re-drives `syncObjectSchema` after `registerDriver`), so the mapping does register and the 3 fixture rows are reachable by a system read. The reported 200-empty is produced by **#7738**'s org-scoping predicate, via SQLite's quoted-identifier fallback turning the unresolvable `organization_id` into a string literal (both disjuncts constant-false). The second evidence item has also expired: a filter on a non-existent column now answers `400 INVALID_FIELD`. This card closes when **#7738** lands and the federated read is re-verified end-to-end. Full record in the ACCEPT comment below.

---

## Symptom

On a stock boot, `GET /api/v1/datasources/showcase_external/remote-tables` returns 200 listing `customers` (7 cols) + `orders` (7 cols), but `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_ext_customer` returns 200 `{"records":[],"total":0}` and a by-id read returns 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` — though the remote SQLite genuinely holds 3 customers / 4 orders (confirmed directly and via the platform's own introspection route). A filter on a **non-existent column** also returns 200 empty rather than a driver error, proving the read never reaches the external SQL driver at all. Reproduced on two fresh-DB boots.

## Root cause

Suspected boot ordering. `No driver available for object, skipping schema sync {"object":"showcase_ext_customer"}` is logged at 09:38:37.014, while `Registered driver {"driverName":"showcase_external"}` and `Auto-connected declared datasources` only happen at 09:38:38.413. In `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` (~lines 1126-1152) the federated branch runs `const driver = this.ql.getDriverForObject(obj.name)`; with the driver not yet registered it takes the `if (!driver)` skip path, so `driver.registerExternalObject(obj)` — the call that installs the object→remote-table mapping (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`) — never runs, leaving the query path with no binding. The read then resolves against nothing and returns empty.

Stale-premise check: `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` has zero diff between the `92f26f75` pin and `origin/main` — not fixed upstream.

## Reproduction

1. Boot the showcase with the `showcase_external` datasource declared.
2. `GET /api/v1/datasources/showcase_external/remote-tables` — 200, lists `customers` + `orders`.
3. `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_ext_customer`.

Expected: the 3 fixture rows. Actual: 200 `{"records":[],"total":0}`; by-id 404; a filter on a non-existent column also 200 empty.

## Source

Extracted from the QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#7690 (framework 92f26f75, console 09987b680).
